wireLogs: [SECTOR_7B]: Unidentified cargo container recovered near Sector 4. Contains 400 lbs of high-grade synthetic caffeine.
[INCIDENT_LOG]: Operative Velch requested a hull inspection; maintenance team declined citing psychological fatigue.
[TEMPORAL_ALERT]: Non-linear causality drift detected in Sub-Sector 12. Chapter order currently fluxing.
[BEACON_COMM]: Incoming transmission from Deep Space Relay 9 intercepted. Signature matches Dr. Roy Hull's frequency.
[LOGISTICS_NOTE]: Supply depot #3 reports zero inventory of 'Velch's Strategic Coffee Mugs'. Requisition pending.
[SECURITY_WARN]: Unapproved attempt to calculate Velch's survival probability crashed local mainframe.
velchQuotes: VELCH_LOG: 'It wasn't a tactical retreat. I simply preferred fighting from the next star system.'
VELCH_LOG: 'Mathematically, if I don't check the navigation sensors, the anomaly isn't there.'
ALERT: Grader Velch has been banned from Sector 4 mess halls due to condiment weaponization.
SYSTEM_NOTE: Velch's luck index remains statistically impossible. Primary probability algorithms offline.
hullQuotes: DR_HULL_NOTE: 'Linear storytelling is a crutch for people who fear temporal paradoxes.'
ACADEMIC_MEMO: Reminding all operatives that Dr. Hull is pronounced BAY-sen. Violators will be reassigned.
DR_HULL_NOTE: 'If your chapter order makes sense chronologically, you aren't trying hard enough.'
